facts.text: I am describing DaySculpting as a 90-day program.
I am describing DaySculpting as a program that teaches people to create success one day at a time.
I am describing DaySculpting as broken down into three segments throughout the day.
I am describing the Morning Lift Process as taking 15 minutes.
I am describing the Mid-Day Reconnect Process as taking 5 minutes.
I am describing the Highlight And Insight Review Process as taking 10 minutes.
I am describing the whole DaySculpting process as taking 30 minutes per day.
I am describing DaySculpting as including a morning email, SMS text, and an inspiring video.
I am describing DaySculpting as including a 3-step Success Step Declaration process.
I am describing DaySculpting as encouraging people to disconnect at the midpoint of the day.
I am describing DaySculpting as saying disconnecting for between 3 to 5 minutes resets the brain and replenishes energy.
I am describing DaySculpting as including a 5-minute Tuning In Re-Connection.
I am describing DaySculpting as using a highlight and insight review process to celebrate successes and identify improvements.
I am describing DaySculpting as targeting specific Chief Aims for life.
I am describing DaySculpting as creating habits to reach those Chief Aims.
I am describing DaySculpting as replacing limiting beliefs (mindtraps) with empowering rituals and habits.
I am describing DaySculpting as carving into subconscious memory thoughts, beliefs, and actions through daily repetition.
I am describing DaySculpting as designed to free up hours in the day while empowering greater success in any area of life.
I am describing DaySculpting as solving an age-old problem about fighting against desired changes.
I am asking whether people feel they deserve more out of life, including more financial freedom and greater rewards.
I am asking whether people want deeper, more empowering relationships and meeting a special someone.
I am asking whether people want a deeper spiritual connection.
I am asking whether people want a more healthy, trim, energetic body.
I am describing a belief that people self-sabotage results with actions they know are not in their best interest.
I am describing DaySculpting as saying the real reason people desire more and do not see results lies in whether a 'Success Switch' in the brain is on or off.
I am describing DaySculpting as flipping the Success Switch back on through simple daily steps.
I am describing DaySculpting as a daily success ritual that shuts down the body's failure reflex.
I am describing DaySculpting as tapping into the brain's success centers in just minutes a day.
I am describing DaySculpting as a 90-day game changer to tap into key success centers of the mind.
I am describing DaySculpting as transforming lousy days into days filled with desired results.
I am describing DaySculpting as teaching the science behind having a MindState of Success.
I am describing DaySculpting as saying most people have their success switch turned off by total accident.
I am describing DaySculpting as teaching how to get more done with more time and more energy left over.
I am describing DaySculpting as teaching a process of building a powerful day that creates a series of 'Dynamic Days'.
I am describing DaySculpting as teaching 'Day Sculpting Principles'.
I am describing DaySculpting as helping keep positive results flowing and put success energy into a permanent 'ON' position.
I am describing DaySculpting as being for people willing to take their life to the next level by creating new success habits.
I am describing DaySculpting as encouraging people to use mental and emotional energy more elegantly to sculpt their day.
I am describing a belief that people have the same 24 hours each day.
I am describing DaySculpting as saying confidence plus discipline leads to desired outcomes.
I am describing DaySculpting as encouraging a solutions-focused change consciousness rather than a fear-based 'I don't know how' mindset.
I am describing a concept of 'neuro-chemistry' and the phrase 'What fires together wires together'.
I am describing DaySculpting as involving being fully present to what is trying to emerge as an ideal future.
I am describing DaySculpting as building confidence each day and a 'possibility muscle'.
I am describing DaySculpting as involving an intended thought process that leads to a more focused and clear out picturing of desires.
I am describing DaySculpting as being about clear and purposeful intention to create energy and a MindState of success that propels action.
I am describing law of attraction as something people may use to manifest what they want in life.
I am describing myself as having self-sabotaged results in the past.
